```{=html}
<section class="collaborate-section">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="collaborate-content">
      <h1>Collaborate with AffineDrift</h1>
      
      <div class="collaborate-intro">
        <p>
          AffineDrift is an open research project focused on understanding the biomechanics of the golf swing 
          through the lens of control-affine systems and multibody dynamics. We welcome collaboration, 
          contributions, and suggestions from researchers, engineers, and golf enthusiasts.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div class="collaborate-options">
        <div class="collaborate-card">
          <h2>Contribute Code or Models</h2>
          <p>
            The AffineDrift repository is hosted on GitHub. To contribute:
          </p>
          <ol>
            <li>Fork <a href="https://github.com/D-sorganization/Golf_Modeling_Suite" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Golf_Modeling_Suite</a> on GitHub.</li>
            <li>Create a feature branch from <code>main</code>.</li>
            <li>Make your changes with clear commit messages describing the physics or engineering motivation.</li>
            <li>Open a pull request describing what you changed and why — link to any relevant article or issue.</li>
          </ol>
          <p>
            Priority contribution areas: pendulum model variants, OpenSim/MuJoCo muscle models, motion capture data processing pipelines, and interactive web tools.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div class="collaborate-card">
          <h2>Propose a Resource Addition</h2>
          <p>
            To suggest a paper, book, video, dataset, or tool for the <a href="../resources/resources.html">Resources</a> section:
          </p>
          <ol>
            <li>Check that it is not already listed.</li>
            <li>Prepare a one-sentence note explaining why it belongs here specifically (not just "it is good").</li>
            <li>Open a GitHub issue titled <code>[Resource] Title — Category</code> with the URL and your relevance note, or use the <a href="contact.html">contact form</a>.</li>
          </ol>
          <p>Accepted entries will be added with attribution.</p>
        </div>

        <div class="collaborate-card">
          <h2>Open Research Questions</h2>
          <p>
            The following questions are identified in the Critiques as unresolved and open to community investigation:
          </p>
          <ul>
            <li><strong>Drift-control ratio units</strong> — developing a dimensionally consistent formulation of DCR across joint-torque and wrench representations.</li>
            <li><strong>Muscle co-contraction baseline</strong> — quantifying how tonic muscle activity changes the effective drift trajectory.</li>
            <li><strong>Passive/active boundary</strong> — empirical criteria for separating drift-dominated and control-dominated phases in captured swing data.</li>
            <li><strong>Cross-sport drift comparison</strong> — applying the AffineDrift decomposition to baseball pitching or tennis serve data.</li>
          </ul>
          <p>
            If you are working on any of these, please reach out via the <a href="contact.html">contact form</a>.
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="collaborate-contact">
        <p>
          <strong>Questions?</strong> Use the <a href="contact.html">contact form</a> or email
          <a href="mailto:dieterolson@AffineDrift.com">dieterolson@AffineDrift.com</a>.
        </p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
```
